items.title: Add c8 devDependency + .c8rc.json config
items.context: Add c8 to root package.json devDependencies at latest stable major. Create .c8rc.json configuring reporters: html + lcov; reports-dir: packages/main/coverage; include: packages/main/src; exclude: dist, node_modules, *-smoke.ts fixtures. Update root .gitignore to exclude packages/main/coverage/.
items.userSees: `grep c8 package.json && cat .c8rc.json && grep coverage .gitignore` shows c8 in devDeps, .c8rc.json with html+lcov reporters and packages/main/coverage report-dir, and .gitignore entry for packages/main/coverage/.

happy.desc: c8 in root devDependencies -> `node -e "const p=require(\"./package.json\"); console.log(p.devDependencies.c8||\"MISSING\")"` prints a version string starting with ^ or a digit (not MISSING); WHY: c8 must be installed for test:coverage to run

.c8rc.json exists at root and is valid JSON with reporter array including html and lcov -> `node -e "const c=require(\"./.c8rc.json\"); if(!Array.isArray(c.reporter)||!c.reporter.includes(\"html\")||!c.reporter.includes(\"lcov\")) throw new Error(\"BAD_REPORTERS:\"+JSON.stringify(c.reporter)); console.log(\"REPORTERS_OK\")"` prints REPORTERS_OK; WHY: HTML + LCOV are the A0-required output formats
.gitignore includes packages/main/coverage/ -> `grep -F packages/main/coverage/ .gitignore | wc -l` outputs at least 1; WHY: coverage output must be gitignored to keep working tree clean

edge.desc: .c8rc.json reports-dir points to packages/main/coverage -> `node -e "const c=require(\"./.c8rc.json\"); if(c[\"reports-dir\"]!==\"packages/main/coverage\") throw new Error(\"BAD_DIR:\"+c[\"reports-dir\"]); console.log(\"DIR_OK\")"` prints DIR_OK; WHY: A0 spec requires this exact path
npm install completes cleanly with c8 added -> `npm install --no-save 2>&1 | grep -cE "error|EBADENGINE"` outputs 0; WHY: install must not break on c8 dep resolution

adversarial.desc: OVER-REACH: packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes.ts byte-identical to main -> `git diff main...HEAD -- packages/main/src/tasks/run-all-smokes.ts | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: runner is frozen (B-6efb DONE)
OVER-REACH: packages/main/smoke-manifest.json byte-identical to main -> `git diff main...HEAD -- packages/main/smoke-manifest.json | wc -l` outputs 0; WHY: manifest is frozen (B-d7c3 DONE)
